overview: Brantford had 104,688 residents in 2021, up 6.2% from 98,563 in 2016, living in 41,673 occupied homes across 98.65 square kilometres. It is a mid-sized city with a steady base of working households.

Food processing, advanced manufacturing and warehousing anchor local jobs, and new residents keep arriving from pricier parts of the GTA. Local businesses compete with Hamilton and Cambridge for those customers, so clear local presence and fair pricing count.
